summary: Apply IFRS 18 presentation requirements through statement mapping, MPM reconciliation and practical reporting checks. Explore the course outline.
lede: IFRS 18 reporting training helps financial reporting, accounting and audit professionals assess statement presentation changes and plan reporting updates. It covers classifying income and expenses, mapping line items to required profit or loss subtotals, and identifying and reconciling management-defined performance measures. Practical exercises address aggregation and disaggregation, Excel review checks and an implementation action plan, with focused coverage of related IAS 7, IFRS 8 and IAS 1 requirements; full implementation treatment is not included.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or advise on financial statements and need to evaluate IFRS 18 presentation changes in their reporting work.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial statement preparation and presentation under IAS 1 is recommended. No coding is required.
